criteria.description: Desired-state-managed service state uses desired_hash versus normalized observed hash for drift detection.
Drift status is in_sync only when desired and observed hashes match and health is acceptable.
Drift status is drifted when desired and observed hashes differ.
Drift status is unknown when normalized observation hash is unavailable.
Runtime observation persistence includes normalized_hash and stores it when normalized_state carries an observation_hash.
Non-desired-state workloads continue to use artifact digest drift detection.
Service-state Nostr projections include desired/observed hash metadata when available.
Normative documentation describes desired-vs-observed hash drift semantics.
